note.zh: A 和 B 永远对着干：A 往右，B 就往左。隔着墙也一样。
note.en: A goes right, B insists on going left. A wall in between? The link doesn’t care.

tip.zh: 一直按 → 就行。
tip.en: Just keep pressing →.

note.zh: 你这边宽敞，B 那边却贴着墙。连线上只要有一个箱子挪不动，这一步就不算。
note.en: Your side is wide open, but B is up against a wall. If any box can’t move, the whole step is off.

tip.zh: 先按 → 看看是谁卡住了，再绕到 A 下面去。
tip.en: Press → to see who’s stuck, then go around under A.

note.zh: ↺ 会让方向拐个弯：你把 A 往右推，B 却往上走，还可能顺手把你顶开。
note.en: ↺ is a turning link: push A right and B goes up — and it might shove you out of the way.

tip.zh: 换几个方向推 A，看看你会被顶到哪儿。
tip.en: Push A from different sides and watch where you get bumped to.

note.zh: 被连线带着走的箱子撞上别人，会把对方也推走，顺带触发对方的连线。按一下，动一串。
note.en: A dragged box shoves whatever it bumps, firing that box’s link too. One press, a whole chain.

tip.zh: 第一下 → 两根连线就都动了。
tip.en: Your very first → lights up both links.

note.zh: 两对箱子各连各的，偏偏挤在一个屋里，磕磕碰碰在所难免。
note.en: Two pairs, each with their own link, crammed into one room. Bumping is inevitable.

tip.zh: 先想好让谁去撞谁。
tip.en: Decide who gets to bump whom.

note.zh: 两对箱子挤在一个小屋里：A—B 右转，C—D 左转。四个箱子四个圈，地方实在不够用。
note.en: Two pairs squeezed into a small room: A—B turns right, C—D turns left. Four boxes, four rings, not much elbow room.

tip.zh: 每推一下，都看看另外三个箱子去哪了。
tip.en: After every push, check where the other three went.

note.zh: 这是上下镜像：A 往上，B 就往下；左右走的时候，两个倒是一起走。
note.en: This is an up-down mirror: A goes up, B goes down. Sideways, they move in step.

tip.zh: 只有上下是反的，左右照常。
tip.en: Left and right are in sync. Only up and down flip.

note.zh: 一对左右镜像，一对上下镜像，两个房间各放两个。镜子那头的箱子可不会给你让路。
note.en: One pair mirrors left-right, one mirrors up-down, two boxes per room. Reflections don’t step aside for you.

tip.zh: 时刻留意另一个房间，别把哪个箱子逼进墙角。
tip.en: Keep an eye on the other room — don’t let a reflection get cornered.

note.zh: 两对上下镜像挤在同一个屋里：左右走时一起走，上下走时就分开。
note.en: Two up-down mirror pairs share one room: sideways they move together, up and down they split.

tip.zh: 别急着往圈里推，先看看每对箱子能停在哪儿。
tip.en: Don’t rush them into rings — first see where each pair can actually stop.

note.zh: 带 › 的连线只管一头：推 A，B 会跟着拐弯；直接推 B，A 理都不理。
note.en: A link with › only works one way: push A and B turns along; push B directly and A couldn’t care less.

tip.zh: B 可以单独推，正好用来把它摆正。
tip.en: B can be pushed on its own — use that to line it up.

note.zh: A 一动，B 就被拽着右转；你单独推 B，A 不管。屋子小，转身的地方不多。
note.en: When A moves, B gets dragged along, turned right. Push B yourself and A ignores it. Not much room to turn around.

tip.zh: 先替 B 找好位置，再让 A 把它带过去。
tip.en: Set B up first, then let A carry it home.

note.zh: A 带 B，B 带 C，一路单向往下传。每传一手方向就变一次：A→B 反着走，B→C 上下镜像。
note.en: A drives B, B drives C, one-way down the line. Each handoff twists it: A→B reverses, B→C mirrors up-down.

tip.zh: 推 C 谁也不会跟着动；推 A，就是三个一起动。
tip.en: Pushing C moves nothing else; pushing A moves all three.

note.zh: 紫色的 K 是道岔：扳到左边一起走，扳到右边反着走。扳完要从下一步才算数。
note.en: Purple K is a track switch: left means same way, right means opposite. It kicks in from your next move.

tip.zh: 两个箱子要去的地方不一样，什么时候该扳一下？
tip.en: The boxes need different destinations. When should you throw the switch?

note.zh: 扳到左边是 A/B、C/D 两对，扳到右边换成 A/D、B/C。怎么换都不会有人落单。
note.en: Left: A/B + C/D. Right: A/D + B/C. Everyone always has a partner.

tip.zh: 扳之前和扳之后，都看清连线两头连的是谁。
tip.en: Watch both ends of every link as you throw the switch.

note.zh: A 一个人带俩：道岔在左边时 B 跟着走、C 反着走；在右边正好倒过来。
note.en: A drags two: on the left B follows and C mirrors; on the right it’s the other way round.

tip.zh: 只扳一次，多半不够。
tip.en: Throwing it once probably won’t do.

note.zh: K 管 A—B，J 管 A—C，各管各的：扳到左边一起走，扳到右边反着走。
note.en: K runs A—B, J runs A—C, each on its own: left means same way, right means opposite.

tip.zh: 两个道岔都得扳一扳。先想好 B 和 C 各要往哪边去。
tip.en: You’ll need to throw both. Work out which way B and C each need to go.

note.zh: 道岔在左边时，A 单向带着 B 走；扳到右边，箭头调个头，变成 B 带着 A 走。
note.en: On the left, A drags B one-way. Throw the switch right and the arrow turns around: now B drags A.

tip.zh: 谁该被带着走，就把箭头指向谁。
tip.en: Point the arrow at whoever needs carrying.

note.zh: A 还是一拖二，但这回两边都会拐弯：道岔在左边时 B 右转、C 跟着走；在右边时 B 跟着走、C 左转。
note.en: A still drags two, but now both can turn: on the left B turns right and C follows; on the right B follows and C turns left.

tip.zh: 这关得来回扳好几次。
tip.en: Expect to throw it back and forth several times.

note.zh: 还是一根单向连线，不过会拐弯：道岔在左边时 A 带 B 右转，在右边换成 B 带 A 左转。
note.en: Still one one-way link, but it turns: on the left A drags B, turned right; on the right B drags A, turned left.

tip.zh: 箭头指向谁，谁就是被带的那个。先想好该挪谁。
tip.en: Whoever the arrow points at gets dragged. Decide who needs to move first.

note.zh: 这回 K 和 J 得一起看：两个道岔左左、左右、右左、右右，四种组合各是一套连线。
note.en: This time read K and J together: left-left, left-right, right-left, right-right — each combination is its own set of links.

tip.zh: 面板里能看到扳一下 K 或 J 会变成什么样。四种连法里，这关至少要用到三种。
tip.en: The panel shows what throwing K or J would give you. You’ll need at least three of the four.

note.zh: A 是你的影子：你走一步，它就反着走一步，空着手走路也算。隔壁的木箱 C 你够不着，影子够得着。
note.en: A is your shadow: every step you take, it takes the opposite one — even just walking. You can’t reach crate C next door, but your shadow can.

tip.zh: 影子撞了墙，你也走不动。
tip.en: If your shadow hits a wall, you’re not going anywhere either.

note.zh: 这个影子就跟在你身边，而且总往你右手边拐。你俩得一起把木箱 C 推到位。
note.en: This shadow lives right next to you and always veers to your right. Team up to get crate C home.

tip.zh: 你去推影子的时候，它自己也在走——两边方向不一样就推不动。
tip.en: When you push your shadow, it’s also walking — if the directions disagree, nothing moves.

note.zh: 道岔决定谁当你的影子：在左边是 A，在右边是 B。没当上的那个也没闲着，它被推时会反着带动影子。
note.en: The switch decides who shadows you: A on the left, B on the right. The other one drags the shadow backwards, one-way.

tip.zh: 先想清楚，每个箱子该在道岔哪一边的时候挪。
tip.en: Work out which box should move with the switch on which side.

note.zh: 两个木箱，一个左右镜像的影子：你往左，它往右；上下倒是一起走。
note.en: Two crates and a left-right mirrored shadow: you go left, it goes right; up and down, you move together.

tip.zh: 别把木箱推进墙角——那边可没人能把它拉出来。
tip.en: Don’t push a crate into a corner — nobody over there can pull it out.

note.zh: 影子跟你住一屋，你往哪走，它就往反方向走。两个木箱，三个圈。
note.en: Your shadow shares the room and always goes the opposite way. Two crates, three rings.

tip.zh: 影子挡路的时候，往反方向走一步，它就退开了。
tip.en: If your shadow is in the way, step the other way and it backs off.

note.zh: 你在这边推一个木箱，影子在那边推另一个，而且是左右镜像。
note.en: You push a crate over here while your mirrored shadow pushes another over there.

tip.zh: 一边推好了，另一边可能刚好卡住。两边得一起想。
tip.en: Finishing one side may leave the other stuck. Think about both at once.

note.zh: 青色方块是压板。每一步开始时，只要上面压着东西，A—B 就会变成反着走。
note.en: The teal tile is a pressure plate. If anything is on it when a move starts, A—B flips to opposite.

tip.zh: 站在压板上推，和离开压板再推，结果不一样。
tip.en: Pushing from the plate and pushing off it give different results.

note.zh: A 和 B 都单向指挥 C。踩下压板，两条指令一起掉头。
note.en: A and B both give C one-way orders. Step on the plate and both orders turn around.

tip.zh: 先规划好 C 的路线，再决定哪几步要踩着压板走。
tip.en: Plan C’s route first, then decide which steps need the plate.

note.zh: 压板踩下时，A—B 从左右镜像变成上下镜像。木箱 C 也能压住压板，可它最后也得进圈。
note.en: With the plate pressed, A—B switches from a left-right to an up-down mirror. Crate C can hold the plate down too — but it also has to end in a ring.

tip.zh: 让 C 替你站一会儿，你就能腾出手来。
tip.en: Let C stand in for a while and your hands are free.

note.zh: 压板一踩，影子就从跟你同向变成反向，B 和影子的关系也跟着掉头。那边还有个木箱，等着影子去推。
note.en: Press the plate and your shadow flips from same-way to opposite — and B’s link to it flips too. Over there, a crate waits for your shadow.

tip.zh: 压板不挑人，B 也能踩。
tip.en: The plate doesn’t care who’s on it — B can press it too.
